title: Use struct bufref where appropriate
body:
This PR turns data that may be allocated or not into `struct bufref`s.
It slightly increases the memory footprint but improves the readability and is less error-prone.

In all new uses of `struct bufref`, the length field is not used, either because they are null-terminated strings or the data may not yet be known when the length is processed.

Thanks in advance for your review.
